content.text:
Here is the entry point:

```rust
fn main() {
    println!("hello");
}
```

And a long line that needs panning:

```sh
cargo run --release -- --agent claude --resume 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --allow --verbose --log-level trace --output /tmp/a/very/long/path/to/a/file.log
```

| name | note |
|---|---|
| a | a rather long note that does not fit in the box at all, so the table is panned |
| b | another long note that sits beside the first one, and goes on and on past the edge |

I will change it and run it.

```console
$ cargo run
   Compiling hello v0.1.0
hello, world
```
